description: This file defines the ProcLimits struct and methods to parse and retrieve process resource limits from the Linux /proc filesystem, specifically from the 'limits' file.

classes.name: ProcLimits
classes.description: Struct representing various resource limits for a process, such as CPU time, file size, memory, and process count.

methods.name: Limits
methods.description: Returns the current soft limits of the process by reading and parsing the 'limits' file in /proc.

methods.name: NewLimits
methods.description: Deprecated method that calls Limits() to retrieve process limits.
